integrity: All normal forms and orbit formulas are explicitly proved; the finite checker is a supplementary reproducibility aid.
scientific_limitations: Classifies composition-idempotent group endomorphisms only for even n at least four. The assertions follow from the included all-n proof; finite checker covers even n=4..32 only. No independent validation and no exhaustive historical priority claim; potential broader group-retract coverage remains a risk.
title: Automorphism-orbit and image-order classification of even dihedral retractions
